title: Pick A: the public 0.487 notebook run verbatim on our account (reproducible base of record)
source: alexchilton/casmi26-lb-0-487-peaks-to-structures-scorer v13 (guhongbin's casmi26-v589-alex0484-extlib code; popwenman's scorer-train-v80 kernel output; Takumu Hata's extlib and samartalwar's MassBank-harmonized libraries)

rules.metric: public LB MRR@25, read as the 3-decimal score Kaggle displays

references.source_evidence: alex chilton's account, submission 58185447 (2026-11-10); IONWRAITH v17 scored 0.487 on two submissions of the same version
references.noise_mechanism: optional stages are skipped when the notebook's time guards trip, so the score depends on the rerun machine (IONWRAITH notes; our E013 found 9-18% of molecules change between two executions of one pipeline)

bands.name: reproduces
bands.consequence: base of record for every later comparison; the user selects it in the UI as one of the two final picks

bands.name: high
bands.consequence: read as run noise, not an improvement; same consequence as reproduces

bands.name: low
bands.consequence: compare our commit log with the source's (image, inputs, time guards); still selected as Pick A unless a cause is found; no resubmission to chase the score (E013: best-of-reruns is selection on noise)

bands.name: fail
bands.consequence: diagnose before anything else; fallback base is the public-only 0.480 notebook (kernel casmi26-pick-a v1, commit run done, not submitted)

rules.frozen_note: Bands written before the score was known.
